title.narrative: Building a Peaceful Future: Youth Empowerment through Media Engagement in Somalia

description.narrative:
The overall objective: to strengthen the principles of living together and the common public space, including freedom of expression and democratic debate, through media engagement.

The specific objectives:

SO 1: Support media partners to engage young people, especially young women, meaningfully and actively;

SO 2: Increase the capacity of young people, especially young women, to actively participate in democratic debate.
